offer.say: HO HO HO! BIG GORD WON'T LET YOU WALK! Sorry. Habit. Skate with Santa, second Saturday. Santa arrives on Doris, like always. This year I want the works: full tank, shiny ice, and the nose. The red nose. On Doris. Earl won't let me. You're the boss. Be the boss.

options.text: Full tank, fresh ice. The nose, I'll think about.
Why does Santa ride a resurfacer?
Earl's the boss of Doris. Not me.

why.say: Because in 1987 the reindeer didn't show! Okay, there were never reindeer. Gus said 'get on the Zambelli' and the kids lost their minds. Now it's tradition. Tradition, plus a little brand awareness.

advert.say: A tiny bit. The suit says 'Big Gord's' on the belt buckle. Small! Tasteful! Kids don't read belt buckles. Dads read belt buckles. Dads need trucks.

decline.say: Earl's the boss of Doris. Ha! That's true. That's the truest thing anybody's said to me all year. Okay. No works. Still coming, though. Santa doesn't cancel.

accepted.say: WONDERFUL. I'll bring candy canes. And a few brochures. For the adults. Small brochures.

p_nose.say: The nose! Yes or no? Be the boss!

options.text: The nose goes on. For one lap. Earl takes it off for the flood.

p_nose_on.say: YES. One lap. Earl will take it off before the flood and put it back after. He won't say anything. He'll do it very loudly.

p_nose_off.say: Antlers only. Earl's rule. You know what, that's fair. She's a lady. A lady with antlers.

p_nose_gord.say: ME? Wear the nose? Oh, that's GOOD. That's an advert. Big Gord, red nose. I'll put it on a billboard. Sorry, Maple Tire.

p_skate.say: I've been practising my wave. It's a truck salesman's wave. It's very sincere.

complete.say: HO HO HO! Two hundred kids! Santa fell off at the north end, but gently, and right on the dead board, so I stopped dead. Ronnie says that's the first time anyone's used the Millbrook bank on purpose since 1977. Here. For the jar.

options.text: Thanks, Gord. Same time next year?

c_next.say: Santa never cancels! Big Gord won't let you... yeah, you know.

c_fell.say: Gently! A gentle fall! The kids thought it was part of the show. Next year, it's part of the show.

c_brochures.say: No brochures. Okay. Maybe a fridge magnet. A tiny fridge magnet.
